title: torch.cuda.is_available 返回 False 的排查方法
content: When torch.cuda.is_available() is False, first inspect torch.__version__, torch.version.cuda, and the GPU driver with nvidia-smi. A CPU-only PyTorch wheel reports torch.version.cuda as None. The NVIDIA driver must support the CUDA runtime bundled with the selected PyTorch wheel; the locally installed CUDA toolkit is not what ordinary prebuilt wheels use at runtime.
summary: 当前 PyTorch 很可能安装了 CPU-only 构建，或 NVIDIA 驱动与该 wheel 自带的 CUDA runtime 不兼容。
resolution: 打印 torch.__version__、torch.version.cuda 和 torch.cuda.is_available()，确认是否为 CUDA 构建。
使用 nvidia-smi 验证驱动能识别 GPU，并对照 PyTorch 官方安装页选择匹配的 CUDA wheel。
在新的虚拟环境中重新安装后再次验证，避免 CPU 与 CUDA wheel 混装。

title: Expected all tensors to be on the same device
content: The RuntimeError 'Expected all tensors to be on the same device' means an operation received tensors or parameters placed on different devices, commonly CPU and CUDA. Moving only the model is insufficient when the input batch or a newly created tensor remains on CPU. Optimizer state restored from a checkpoint may also need device migration.
summary: 模型参数、输入张量或优化器状态分布在不同设备上，导致同一次运算混用了 CPU 与 CUDA。
resolution: 打印 model 参数和每个输入张量的 device，定位不一致项。
将模型与输入统一移动到同一 torch.device；创建新张量时显式继承现有张量的 device。
恢复 checkpoint 后检查 optimizer state 中的 tensor，并在需要时移动到目标设备。

title: Windows 下 DataLoader 多进程重复启动或卡住
content: On Windows, multiprocessing uses spawn instead of fork. DataLoader code that creates worker processes must be protected by if __name__ == '__main__'. Top-level dataset definitions should be picklable. For diagnosis, set num_workers=0; after the code is safe, increase it gradually. Persistent workers should only be enabled when num_workers is greater than zero.
summary: Windows 使用 spawn 启动 DataLoader worker；缺少 main 入口保护或对象不可序列化会造成重复执行、卡住或 RuntimeError。
resolution: 把训练入口放进 main()，并使用 if __name__ == '__main__': main() 保护。
临时把 num_workers 设为 0 验证是否为多进程问题。
确保 Dataset、collate_fn 等定义在模块顶层且可以被 pickle，再逐步增加 worker 数。

title: CUDA out of memory 的系统排查
content: CUDA out of memory is caused by peak allocated memory, retained computation graphs, fragmentation, or another process using the GPU. During inference use torch.inference_mode() or torch.no_grad(). During training reduce batch size, use automatic mixed precision and gradient accumulation, and avoid storing loss tensors with attached graphs. torch.cuda.memory_summary() helps distinguish allocation patterns.
summary: 显存峰值超过可用容量，或计算图被意外保留；应先定位峰值，再从批量、精度和图生命周期优化。
resolution: 用 nvidia-smi 与 torch.cuda.memory_summary() 检查其他进程、已分配和保留显存。
推理使用 torch.inference_mode()；训练先减小 batch size，并考虑 AMP 与梯度累积。
不要把带计算图的 loss/tensor 长期追加到列表；记录标量时使用 .item() 或 detach()。

title: PyTorch 2.6 torch.load 的 weights_only 默认值变化
content: Starting in PyTorch 2.6, torch.load defaults to weights_only=True when pickle_module is not passed. The restricted unpickler accepts tensors, primitive types, dictionaries, and explicitly allowlisted globals. Loading an older checkpoint that stores a full nn.Module or custom class can raise an UnpicklingError. Only for a trusted checkpoint, either load with weights_only=False or allowlist the required classes; untrusted pickle files can execute arbitrary code.
summary: PyTorch 2.6 将 torch.load 的 weights_only 默认改为 True，旧的整模型或自定义类 checkpoint 可能因此反序列化失败。
resolution: 优先保存和加载 state_dict，而不是序列化整个 nn.Module。
确认 checkpoint 来源可信后，显式传入 weights_only=False，或通过 safe_globals 仅放行必要类型。
绝不要对未知来源的 pickle/checkpoint 关闭 weights_only 安全限制。

title: PyTorch 2.5 及更早版本的 torch.load 行为
content: In PyTorch 2.5 and earlier, torch.load generally uses weights_only=False by default. Applications can opt into weights_only=True when loading a state_dict-like checkpoint. Because the unrestricted pickle loader can execute code, checkpoint provenance still matters even though an older version does not show the PyTorch 2.6 default-change error.
summary: PyTorch 2.5 及更早版本通常默认使用不受限的 pickle 加载，不会触发 2.6 的默认值变化，但仍有反序列化安全风险。
resolution: 确认当前 torch 版本后再判断是否属于 2.6 默认值变化。
对只包含权重的 checkpoint 主动使用 weights_only=True。
只加载可信来源的旧式整模型 checkpoint。

title: state_dict 的 Missing key 与 Unexpected key
content: load_state_dict reports Missing key(s) when the target module expects parameters absent from the checkpoint, and Unexpected key(s) when the checkpoint contains names absent from the target. A common cause is the 'module.' prefix added by DataParallel. strict=False suppresses the exception but does not prove that the intended weights were loaded, so applications must inspect both returned key lists.
summary: checkpoint 参数名与当前模型结构不一致，常见原因包括 DataParallel 的 module. 前缀或模型结构变化。
resolution: 比较 model.state_dict().keys() 与 checkpoint.keys()，定位前缀或结构差异。
仅在确认差异符合预期时转换 module. 前缀或使用 strict=False。
检查 load_state_dict 返回的 missing_keys 和 unexpected_keys，不能忽略结果。

title: CUDA error: device-side assert triggered
content: A CUDA device-side assert often originates from an earlier asynchronous kernel, so the displayed stack frame may be misleading. In classification it commonly means a target index is outside [0, num_classes), or an embedding index is outside the vocabulary. Reproduce on CPU for a clearer error and validate min/max indices before the operation. CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 is a debugging aid, not a production fix.
summary: 标签或 embedding 索引越界最常触发 device-side assert，而 CUDA 异步执行会让报错位置看起来不准确。
resolution: 在送入 loss 或 embedding 前打印索引的 dtype、最小值和最大值。
在 CPU 上复现以获得更直接的越界错误。
仅在调试时设置 CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1，修复真实的数据或类别范围问题。

title: no_grad 与 inference_mode 的推理使用
content: torch.no_grad disables gradient calculation, reducing memory use during inference. torch.inference_mode is more restrictive and additionally removes view tracking and version counter overhead. model.eval() is separate: it changes modules such as Dropout and BatchNorm but does not disable autograd. Production inference normally uses both model.eval() and an inference_mode context.
summary: model.eval() 与关闭梯度解决不同问题；稳定推理通常同时使用 eval() 和 torch.inference_mode()。
resolution: 推理前调用 model.eval()，切换 Dropout 与 BatchNorm 行为。
使用 with torch.inference_mode(): 包裹前向计算。
若后续代码需要 autograd 记录或版本计数，再退回 torch.no_grad()。

title: Tokenizer 没有 pad_token 导致批量 padding 失败
content: Some causal language model tokenizers do not define a pad token. Calling the tokenizer with padding=True can raise 'Asking to pad but the tokenizer does not have a padding token'. For decoder-only inference, setting tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token is often appropriate, but training may require adding a dedicated special token and resizing model embeddings.
summary: 当前 tokenizer 未定义 pad_token；推理可复用 eos_token，训练是否新增专用 token 需结合任务判断。
resolution: 检查 tokenizer.pad_token 与 model.config.pad_token_id。
decoder-only 推理通常可设置 tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token，并同步 pad_token_id。
若训练需要独立 padding 语义，使用 add_special_tokens 后调用 resize_token_embeddings。

title: device_map='auto' 需要 Accelerate
content: Transformers delegates device_map='auto' placement to the Accelerate library. If Accelerate is missing or too old, from_pretrained can raise an ImportError. Install a compatible accelerate release in the same environment, restart the Python process, and verify that pip and python point to the same interpreter. For training, automatic device maps designed for inference are not a substitute for a distributed training strategy.
summary: device_map='auto' 依赖 Accelerate；缺包、版本过旧或 pip 装到了另一个环境都会导致 ImportError。
resolution: 运行 python -m pip show accelerate，确认包安装在当前解释器环境。
安装或升级兼容版本后重启 Python/Notebook 内核。
训练场景使用明确的分布式策略，不要把推理用 device_map 当作训练方案。

title: Transformers 离线模式与本地缓存
content: Models and tokenizers can be loaded without network access when all required files are already cached or stored in a local directory. Set HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 and use local_files_only=True to prevent network calls. A snapshot must include config, tokenizer files, and model weights. Pin a revision before preparing the snapshot so that the deployment is reproducible.
summary: 离线加载要求模型、配置和 tokenizer 文件完整存在于缓存或本地目录，并显式禁止联网。
resolution: 在有网络的构建阶段固定 revision 并下载完整模型快照。
部署时设置 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1，并在 from_pretrained 中使用 local_files_only=True。
启动前校验 config、tokenizer 与权重文件，缺失时快速失败。

title: TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM fork 警告
content: The tokenizers library can warn that the current process was forked after parallelism had already been used. This protects against deadlocks caused by inherited thread pools. Create worker processes before using the tokenizer, instantiate the tokenizer inside each worker, or explicitly configure TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM. Silencing the warning without fixing unsafe process order can hide a real hang risk.
summary: 父进程先使用 tokenizer、随后 fork worker，可能继承线程池并产生死锁风险。
resolution: 优先在 worker 启动后再创建或使用 tokenizer。
检查 DataLoader 或服务进程的 fork/spawn 顺序。
只有确认执行模型安全后才显式设置 TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM。

title: TrainingArguments 使用 eval_strategy
content: In recent Transformers releases including 4.46, TrainingArguments exposes eval_strategy for choosing when evaluation runs. Code or third-party callbacks written against older releases may still refer to evaluation_strategy and raise an AttributeError in a mismatched environment. Inspect the installed signature and pin compatible versions across transformers, accelerate, and integration packages.
summary: Transformers 4.46 环境应使用当前 TrainingArguments 的 eval_strategy；旧代码或回调引用 evaluation_strategy 会发生版本不匹配。
resolution: 打印 transformers.__version__ 并检查 TrainingArguments 签名。
在 4.46 代码中使用 eval_strategy，或安装与旧项目锁文件一致的版本。
同时锁定 transformers、accelerate 和相关 Trainer 集成依赖。

title: 旧版 TrainingArguments 的 evaluation_strategy
content: Transformers 4.30 documentation uses the evaluation_strategy argument in TrainingArguments. Copying a new-version example that uses eval_strategy into this older environment can raise an unexpected keyword argument error. The correct fix is to align code with the installed API or upgrade using a tested dependency lock.
summary: Transformers 4.30 的 TrainingArguments 文档使用 evaluation_strategy，不能直接照搬新版本的 eval_strategy 参数。
resolution: 确认安装的是 4.30 后，将参数写为 evaluation_strategy。
若要使用新版 API，升级并重新验证 Trainer 相关依赖。
提交 requirements/lock 文件避免团队环境漂移。

title: FastAPI 返回 422 Unprocessable Entity
content: FastAPI returns HTTP 422 when the request reaches the route but cannot be validated against the declared Pydantic model or parameter location. Compare the JSON body with the generated /docs schema, including required fields, nesting, aliases, and data types. A parameter declared without a Pydantic body model may be interpreted as a query parameter.
summary: 请求已经到达 FastAPI，但 body 结构、字段类型或参数位置与 Pydantic 契约不一致。
resolution: 查看 422 响应的 detail.loc 和 msg，定位具体字段与 body/query 路径。
在 /docs 中按 OpenAPI schema 重放请求，核对 Content-Type、嵌套和必填字段。
为复杂 JSON 定义明确的 Pydantic 请求模型，避免 body 与 query 参数混淆。

title: async 路由中阻塞事件循环
content: An async def route runs on the event loop. Calling blocking file, CPU-heavy, or synchronous SDK code directly inside it can stall other requests. Use a normal def route for blocking work that FastAPI can place in a thread pool, call run_in_threadpool for a bounded synchronous function, or move heavy CPU work to a separate worker process. Merely adding async to a blocking library does not make it non-blocking.
summary: async def 中直接执行同步阻塞或 CPU 密集任务会卡住事件循环，从而放大并发延迟。
resolution: 用性能日志确认阻塞发生在同步 I/O 还是 CPU 计算。
对短小同步调用使用 run_in_threadpool；对 CPU 重任务使用独立 worker。
为外部调用设置超时和并发上限，避免线程池耗尽。

title: BackgroundTasks 的适用边界
content: FastAPI BackgroundTasks runs work after the response in the same application process. It is suitable for small best-effort tasks, not durable jobs that must survive restarts or require retries. Long model inference, index rebuilds, and critical email/payment workflows should use a durable queue and separate worker with idempotency and observability.
summary: BackgroundTasks 不提供持久化、跨进程调度或可靠重试，不适合长任务和关键任务。
resolution: 只把短小、可丢失、无复杂重试需求的工作放入 BackgroundTasks。
索引重建或长模型任务使用持久化队列与独立 worker。
为任务设计幂等键、重试策略、状态查询和失败监控。

title: FastAPI 与 Pydantic v2 迁移
content: FastAPI 0.100 added support for Pydantic v2 while retaining a migration period. In Pydantic v2, model.dict() is replaced by model_dump(), parse_obj by model_validate(), and validators use updated APIs. Mixing plugins or examples written only for Pydantic v1 can cause import or validation errors. Pin compatible FastAPI/Pydantic versions and migrate deprecations explicitly.
summary: FastAPI/Pydantic 主版本不一致会造成验证器、序列化方法或导入路径错误，应按 v2 API 迁移并锁定依赖。
resolution: 打印 fastapi 与 pydantic 版本，确认组合是否受支持。
把 dict/parse_obj/旧 validator 等调用迁移到 model_dump/model_validate/新版 validator。
在 CI 中同时运行契约测试并提交依赖锁文件。

title: FastAPI 浏览器 CORS 配置
content: A browser enforces CORS when frontend and API origins differ by scheme, host, or port. Configure CORSMiddleware with an explicit allow_origins list. When allow_credentials=True, wildcard origins, methods, and headers are unsafe or restricted; enumerate trusted origins. CORS is a browser policy and is not authentication or authorization.
summary: 跨域失败需要在服务端显式允许可信前端 origin；CORS 不能替代鉴权。
resolution: 确认浏览器页面与 API 的 scheme、host、port，从而确定真实 origin。
使用 CORSMiddleware 明确列出可信 allow_origins。
需要 cookie/Authorization 时避免通配符，并同时实施真正的鉴权。

title: NVIDIA driver、CUDA runtime 与本地 toolkit 的关系
content: Prebuilt PyTorch wheels ship the CUDA runtime libraries they need. The system NVIDIA driver must be new enough for that runtime. Installing a different local CUDA toolkit usually does not change which runtime an ordinary wheel uses; the toolkit matters when compiling custom CUDA extensions. Diagnose with nvidia-smi, torch.version.cuda, and the exact installed wheel tag.
summary: 普通 PyTorch wheel 使用其自带 CUDA runtime；系统驱动必须兼容，本地 toolkit 主要影响自定义扩展编译。
resolution: 用 torch.version.cuda 确认 wheel 对应 runtime，而不是只看 nvcc --version。
用 nvidia-smi 确认驱动与 GPU 状态，并对照 PyTorch 安装矩阵。
只有编译 CUDA 扩展时再重点核对本地 toolkit、编译器和 ABI。
